name: button
title: Button
description: UDesign action control with semantic variants, press and pending feedback, and accessible touch targets.
docs: The pending prop disables the control, reports aria-busy, and swaps in a spinner while preserving the button's width so the layout does not jump when the work starts. Press treatment is per-variant: a neutral surface darkens to the pressed role while a solid surface has no deeper solid role to move to, and every variant keeps a non-motion colour signal since --motion-press-scale collapses to 1 under reduced motion. See DESIGN.md.
